name: Dumbbell Lying Alternating Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and extend a dumbbell above each shoulder, palms facing inward.
Hold one arm locked straight while bending the opposite elbow to lower that dumbbell beside your temple.
Extend the bent elbow to press that dumbbell smoothly back above your shoulder.
Alternate arms while keeping both upper arms steady.
tips: Point both upper arms straight toward the ceiling without letting your elbows flare.
Keep your wrists straight and lower slowly to protect your elbows and face.
